payload.title: One core card set for stories, references, threads and wiki entries
payload.description:
What: cards rendered from data by core, ported once from MoM's components. Cards carry what they need on the row (no further lookups; see PPY-7f1e54).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A card renders from its data alone
  Given a Reference row with prediction, image and summary
  When a listing renders
  Then no extra lookup is made and the card matches the golden render
